description: Discovers mentors, peers, and complementary operators for YOUR operator on the SigRank leaderboard. Uses your enrolled device identity — no codename needed. Finds operators you should learn from: (1) Mentors — 1-2 class tiers above you with similar cascade shapes, including the specific pillar delta that explains the yield gap (e.g. '12× your cache reads'). (2) Peers — same class tier, ranked by yield proximity. (3) Complementary — operators whose strength is your weakness. Use this after submit_verified to find who to learn from, then chain into self_improve with the mentor's pillar deltas as context. Requires enrollment (npx sigrank-mcp enroll). Intent: DISCOVER_PEERS.

inputSchema.description: Optional: platform filter and result count. Uses your enrolled identity to determine your operator.

n.description: Number of operators to return per category (default: 5, max: 20).

platform.description: Filter peers by platform (default: your operator's primary platform). Use 'all' to search across all platforms.
